blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — A nationwide campaign launched recently in Cebu is seeking to push for the passage of an Anti-Political Dynasty Law through a People’s Initiative, allowing registered voters to directly propose legislation aimed at curbing the concentration of political power among a few families.
